semantics.inventory: Name-based candidate sensitive fields. Confirm semantics in source before making privacy claims.
semantics.potentialLogging: A logging call near a candidate field name. This is a review lead, not proof that a runtime value is logged.
semantics.externalTransfers: An external HTTP destination and sensitive parameters in the same integration client. This is a provider-sharing review lead, not proof of every runtime payload.

externalTransfers.evidence: External HttpClient destination and sensitive method parameters occur in the same integration client. Verify the runtime data flow in source.
